snippet.title: Teardown: The Greenwash Gambit
snippet.description:
A stranded Löckonaut. A planet-sized cover-up. A black hole on the brink. Join Tier-1 and Mainframe in The Greenwash Gambit, Teardown’s space-bound DLC. Explore zero-G environments, gravity anomalies, and sabotage E.F.O. Corp’s galactic waste scheme before it’s too late.
Available on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

We're currently putting a lot of effort into multiplayer and the next console mod pack. More to come soon.

Grab Teardown on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167630/Teardown/
